import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a violin plot to compare the distribution of sleep duration and quality across different age groups
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='Age', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', data=sleep_health, split=True, ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Age and Gender')
ax.set_xlabel('Age')
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax.legend(title='Gender')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
